comparison.objective: Send a loaded tote down a passive roller conveyor to the far station without a hard impact.
comparison.physical_skill: Impulse regulation and prediction of rolling motion while preserving an upright load.
comparison.success_condition: Tote stops at the target station, released and still; bottle remains upright and contained; tote is not lifted or tipped.
comparison.reason: This tests calibrated ballistic transport on rollers, not contact-maintained bimanual alignment or containment of free bearing balls.
